OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

WORLD: this scene happens inside her own world — the world of the attached image — as if she simply lives there: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic. skin_exposure: bold — inside the crop, the chosen outfit is worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and collarbones, skin clearly showing; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; intimate areas covered
